newsitem.title: INDIA: Reliance results lift Delhi shares.
newsitem.headline: Reliance results lift Delhi shares.

text.p: Delhi share prices quoted higher in thin early trade on Wednesday as a rise in net profit at Reliance Industries helped to spur modest buying, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was up 2.58 points to 792.48 after 30 minutes of trade.
Reliance Industries on Tuesday reported that 1996/97 (April-March) net profit rose to 13.23 billion rupees from 13.05 billion in the previous year.
The petrochemicals giant said its sales rose to 87.3 billion rupees from 77.86 billion in the previous year. It also announced a dividend of 6.50 rupees per share compared with six rupees last year.
"It seems that Reliance Industry's working results had some positive impact today," said Ashok Kaul of brokers Rajpaul Chadha and brokers.
Reliance Industries rose 1.85 rupees to 303.00, brokers said.
TISCO gained 4.35 rupees to 180.70 on buying by domestic financial institutions, they said.
State Bank of India quoted 3.25 rupees higher at 311.00.
Larsen and Toubro increased 1.45 rupees to 228.95.
